args.description: Arguments appended after the subcommand (e.g. ["build"] for `npm run build`).

cwd.description: Optional sub-directory (relative to workspace) to run npm in. Defaults to the workspace root.

timeout_secs.description: Optional wall-clock timeout (seconds) before npm is killed. No timeout by default — installs/builds run to completion. Capped at 1800s; 0 disables.
